failure_screenshot.button_trait_limit: Assertion combines isEnabled and isHittable; raw separate trait values and Cancel frame are not retained.

content.scope: package metadata only; existing pins and all dependency declarations unchanged

tcc_provisioning.scope: Pinned CI scripts provision signature-bound grants after the final build and before tests. Unchanged app/requirements are independently verified.
tcc_provisioning.limit: Do not claim microphone authorization from script completion or AX trust; banner is retained in the actual UI screenshot.

independent_review.scope: Second read-only reviewer independently decoded raw records, Core names, native members, signing identities and absent Release.
independent_review.result: No count/source/identity mismatch. UI root-cause analysis is owned separately.

limits: Overall full gate failed at Prompt Cancel interactivity; Release and packaging did not execute.
Unit skips are actual gated records, not executed provider/import/store evidence. Six native methods executed separately.
All ten new CLI methods passed in the app-hosted suite; separate CLI lifetime comparison is a distinct scope and is not silently combined.
Native context tests use real engine/recorder and capture-call spies, not ASR or OS clipboard/screen-content reads.
Native pipeline recognition and child output are synthetic; in-memory History save visibility is not crash/relaunch durability.
Native cleanup observations are unavailable or still readable; neither proves window closure.
No independent TCC database readback, saved-Keychain, physical-keyboard, human-speech, general provider quality, rich-text or notarized distribution proof.
Screenshot banner and combined Cancel assertion do not alone establish product root cause or separate enabled/hittable values.
Companion-head UI/store/CLI proofs remain separate; no future working-tree code is attributed to this run.
